ssh.description: SSH lists the CIDRs allowed to reach port 22. Empty closes SSH on the cloud firewall.

api.description: API lists the CIDRs allowed to reach the Nomad API on port 4646. Left out, it is 0.0.0.0/0: mTLS and ACLs protect the API, and tent warns while it is open to everyone. An empty list is an error, because tent needs the API.

Access.description: Access says who may reach the nodes from the internet.

region.description: Region is a Vultr region (ams) or a Hetzner network zone (eu-central).

zones.description: Zones are the failure domains. Vultr has none: left out, zones is [region], and any other value is an error. On Hetzner they are locations such as fsn1 and must be given.

vultr.description: Vultr holds Vultr settings. Set it only when the provider is vultr.

hetzner.description: Hetzner holds Hetzner settings. Set it only when the provider is hetzner.

Cloud.description: Cloud says where the cluster runs.

spec.description: Spec is what the operator wants the cluster to be.

Cluster.description: Cluster is a Nomad cluster on one cloud provider.

name.description: Name of the cluster: 2 to 20 characters, [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,18}[a-z0-9], and not a name Windows reserves, such as con or com1. It prefixes every resource name.

version.description: Version of Nomad, for example 2.0.7. Empty means the version that the cluster was first built with; a new cluster gets the one that the channel recommends.

region.description: Region is the Nomad region. Defaults to global.

tls.description: TLS configures mTLS on the Nomad API.

clientIntroduction.description: ClientIntroduction is strict, warn or none. Defaults to strict, or to warn when the cluster has a combined group; strict is an error with a combined group, whose client registers before intro tokens exist.

extraConfig.description: ExtraConfig is HCL added to the agents as 99-user.hcl. It is not validated or supported.

ClusterNomad.description: ClusterNomad configures the Nomad agents of the whole cluster.

channel.description: Channel names the release channel, which sets the Nomad versions that the cluster may run and the version of the CNI plugins. Defaults to stable.

cloud.description: Cloud says where the cluster runs.

networking.description: Networking is the cluster's private network.

access.description: Access says who may reach the nodes from the internet.

sshKeys.description: SSHKeys are public keys installed on every node, for diagnostics only.

nomad.description: Nomad configures the Nomad agents of the whole cluster.

ClusterSpec.description: ClusterSpec is what the operator wants the cluster to be.

server.description: Server is added to server and combined nodes.

client.description: Client is added to client and combined nodes.

ExtraConfig.description: ExtraConfig is HCL added to the agents as 99-user.hcl.

HetznerCloud.description: HetznerCloud holds Hetzner settings of a cluster. There are none yet.

cidr.description: CIDR of the private network, a private IPv4 prefix. Defaults to 10.64.0.0/16.

Networking.description: Networking is the cluster's private network.

metadata.description: Metadata names the node group and its cluster.

spec.description: Spec is what the operator wants the node group to be.

NodeGroup.description: NodeGroup is a set of identical nodes in one cluster.

name.description: Name of the node group: 2 to 20 characters, [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,18}[a-z0-9], and not a name Windows reserves, such as con or com1.

cluster.description: Cluster is the name of the cluster the group belongs to.

NodeGroupMeta.description: NodeGroupMeta names a node group and its cluster.

nodePool.description: NodePool of the clients. Defaults to the node pool named default for client and combined groups.

drivers.description: Drivers are the task drivers the clients enable, for example docker and exec.

meta.description: Meta is client metadata that jobs can use in constraints.

NodeGroupNomad.description: NodeGroupNomad configures the Nomad clients of a group.

role.description: Role is server, client or combined.

machineType.description: MachineType is the provider's plan or server type, for example vc2-2c-4gb on Vultr or cx23 on Hetzner.

image.description: Image is the operating system image by name. Defaults to ubuntu-24.04.

size.description: Size is the number of nodes. A server or combined group has 1, 3 or 5; a client group has 0 or more.

zones.description: Zones the nodes are spread over, a subset of the cluster zones. Defaults to all cluster zones.

nomad.description: Nomad configures the Nomad clients of the group. Server groups leave it empty.

NodeGroupSpec.description: NodeGroupSpec is what the operator wants the node group to be.

verifyHTTPSClient.description: VerifyHTTPSClient requires client certificates on the HTTP API. Defaults to true; tent ui keeps the browser working either way.

TLS.description: TLS configures mTLS on the Nomad API.

VultrCloud.description: VultrCloud holds Vultr settings of a cluster. There are none yet.
